learning_outcomes.text: Basic knowledge of production and manufacturing systems.
Applied knowledge of manufacturing systems and processes, metrology, and quality control.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Adequate knowledge of the concept of a company, its institutional and legal framework. Business organization and management.
Identifies and knows production management systems.
Recognizes the most important demand forecasting methods and considers them for inventory control.
Defines production plans by planning material requirements and work methods.
Knows and selects the ideal storage and handling systems for a specific warehouse.
Establishes a maintenance, safety, and occupational risk plan for equipment and facilities in a company.
Uses computer tools to model, simulate, and evaluate different scenarios considering cost and efficiency.
